paragraphs: SurePassID sells deploy-anywhere multi-factor authentication for IT/OT and critical infrastructure, deployable in the cloud, on-premise, or within air-gapped networks. It covers Windows, MacOS, and Linux logins with offline 2FA and fronts cloud and on-prem apps through SAML2, OIDC, and LDAP identity providers. The company cites 99.999% availability, redundancy, and automatic failover, and markets the product for compliance with OMB M-22-09, CMMC 2.0, and NIS2. It supports phishing-resistant MFA through FIDO2/WebAuthn passkeys and security keys as well as OATH HOTP, TOTP, and OCRA tokens and mobile push.

SurePassID has provided on-premise MFA since its founding in 2012 and says 50% of its customer base, including Fortune 500 companies, uses it on-premise. It also serves financial services, having introduced a private cloud authentication server for online payments licensed by Visa, MasterCard, American Express, First Data, and Discover. About 33% of its install base runs in air-gapped environments, and it provides air-gapped MFA to 11 of 16 critical infrastructure sectors. It offers turnkey MFA for SCIFs and SAPFs and pre-built integrations for SCADA systems such as EcoStruxure Geo SCADA Expert.

Private cloud deployments run in Microsoft Azure Commercial, GCC, and GCC High and in Amazon AWS and AWS GovCloud. As a SAML 2.0 identity provider it adds MFA to existing IAM tools such as Microsoft Entra, Okta, or Ping, and integrates with Workday, Oracle, and SAP directories.

quote.text: SurePassID drives Zero Trust everywhere. Deploy MFA for IT/OT in the cloud, on-premise, or within air-gapped networks.
